carta-agm-deck-builder.name: AGM deck builder
prompts: Produce an annual general meeting deck to show our investors

carta-brand-extraction.name: Brand board
prompts: Build a brand board for {{FIRM}} from our website

whatsNewCopy.headline: Turn your firm's website into a ready-to-use brand board
whatsNewCopy.body: Pulls colors, fonts, logos and imagery from your website into an HTML, PDF or slide brand board, then saves it to Carta for future decks.

carta-compliance-routing.name: Form ADV
prompts: Prepare our Form ADV: Regulatory AUM and Schedule D by fund

whatsNewCopy.headline: Prepare Form ADV regulatory AUM and Schedule D
whatsNewCopy.body: Turns Carta fund and investor data into an interactive filing guide and Excel file, counting each LP once and flagging what you enter by hand.

carta-consolidating-financial-reports.name: Consolidated financial reports
prompts: Show me my firm's balance sheet as of this month
Show me my firm's P&L as of this month

whatsNewCopy.headline: Build a firm-wide P&L, balance sheet and trial balance
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads live Carta Fund Admin data into Excel, with the entities you pick side by side and an optional P&L by department or tag.

carta-co-investors.name: Co-investor lookup
prompts: Who are other investors who have co-invested in my portfolio companies?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See who invests alongside you across your portfolio
whatsNewCopy.body: Ranks your most frequent co-investors from stock purchase agreements in Carta, in an interactive report where any company opens its round-by-round investors.

carta-data-collection.name: Portfolio data collection
prompts: Set up data collection for {{FIRM}}'s portfolio companies
Which portfolio companies have not sent their numbers this quarter?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Collect financials and KPIs from every portfolio company
whatsNewCopy.body: Opens a prefilled request form from your Carta portfolio roster, sends one-off or recurring requests, and shows who is overdue so you can chase them.

carta-download-tearsheet.name: Tear sheet download
prompts: Use my firm's tear sheet template and generate tear sheets for this quarter

carta-explore-data.name: Ask about your fund data
prompts: What is the NAV of each of my funds as of the latest quarter?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Ask about NAV, IRR or ownership in plain English
whatsNewCopy.body: Queries the Carta data warehouse and answers in chat with a clean table, adding any CRM or portfolio data your firm loads alongside it.

carta-fund-admin-requests.name: Fund admin requests
prompts: Ask my fund admin team to [describe the task]
What requests do I have open with Carta?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Hand any task to your Carta Fund Admin team
whatsNewCopy.body: Drafts a detailed request naming the fund, period and amounts, sends it only after you approve, then tracks your Carta team's replies in chat.

carta-fund-forecasting.name: Fund forecasting
prompts: What is my funds' TVPI projected at fund close?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Check projected TVPI and IRR at fund close
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads your Carta Fund Forecasting models and answers in chat, showing today's numbers next to the planned and current forecasts at fund close.

carta-fund-modeling.name: Fund modeling
prompts: Spin up the fund modeling app for {{FIRM}}

carta-gp-cash-reconciliation.name: Answer cash reconciliation questions
prompts: What transactions does Carta need me to explain?
Draft answers for my uncategorized cash transactions

whatsNewCopy.headline: Draft answers for every unreconciled bank transaction
whatsNewCopy.body: Works out each transaction from your Carta vendors, partners and past answers, shows every draft beside the chat, and sends nothing until you approve.

carta-manco.name: Budgeting & actuals
prompts: Compare YTD actuals against the budget
Build what-if scenarios over our budget
Build a fund/ManCo budget in Excel from Carta prior-year actuals

whatsNewCopy.headline: Plan next year's ManCo budget from last year's actuals
whatsNewCopy.body: Pulls Carta Fund Admin actuals into an Excel budget workbook, then tracks pacing against plan and models what-ifs like new hires or fund raises.

carta-manco-reporting.name: ManCo reporting dashboard
prompts: Spin up the ManCo dashboard for {{FIRM}}

carta-portfolio-analytics-app.name: Portfolio analytics
prompts: Spin up the portfolio analytics app for {{FIRM}}

carta-portfolio-analytics-routing.name: Schedule of investments & performance
prompts: Show me the schedule of investments for my firm
Show me the TVPI, DPI, MOIC and IRR for my funds
How do our funds compare to peer benchmarks?

whatsNewCopy.headline: View each fund's holdings and its peer ranking
whatsNewCopy.body: Opens a refreshable Schedule of Investments from Carta data in your sidebar, and ranks fund IRR, TVPI and DPI against peers of the same vintage.

carta-portfolio-valuations.name: Portfolio valuations
prompts: Work on {{FIRM}}'s portfolio valuations for this quarter
Which of {{FIRM}}'s portfolio companies need new valuations?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Start this quarter's valuations across many companies at once
whatsNewCopy.body: Opens your Carta portfolio valuations dashboard, shows which companies need a new valuation, and creates drafts for one company or many in a single pass.

carta-spa-audit.name: SPA coverage audit
prompts: Which of our investments are missing an executed SPA?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Find investments missing a signed stock purchase agreement
whatsNewCopy.body: Sorts every equity investment in Carta into missing, unsigned, signed or not needed, ranked by cost basis in an interactive report you can drill into.

carta-waterfall-modeling.name: Waterfall modeling
prompts: Who gets paid, and how much, if [portfolio company] exits at $[amount]?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Model who gets paid, and how much, at exit
whatsNewCopy.body: Runs a waterfall on a portfolio company's Carta cap table, shows each holder's payout in chat or Excel, and can update your holding values.

carta-upload-firm-document.name: Upload a firm document
prompts: Upload [file path] to {{FIRM}}'s Documents page
Add this side letter to our firm documents in Carta

whatsNewCopy.headline: Upload files straight to your firm's Carta Documents page
whatsNewCopy.body: Sends one or many files from your computer to your firm's Documents page in Carta, which then classifies each document for you automatically.

carta-download-firm-document.name: Download a firm document
prompts: Get me the LPA from {{FIRM}}'s Documents page
Download our audit engagement letter from Carta

whatsNewCopy.headline: Fetch any LPA, side letter or notice from Carta
whatsNewCopy.body: Searches your firm's Carta Documents page by title, type or fund, then saves the file to your Downloads folder or hands you a link.
